description: Ask Jev, TypeSafe's System One model, typed questions about text, JSON or images and get calibrated probabilities back for code to act on.

api.description: List the TypeSafe model names and aliases this key can use, such as jev-latest

fields.type: { name: string, description: string, release_date: string }[]

api.description: Ask Jev typed questions about text, JSON or images in one call: yes/no (probability), choice (one option), score (ordered levels) or box (locate in an image). Answers come back with calibrated probabilities.

fields.description: Model name or alias from models.list. jev-latest moves with each release; pin a version such as jev-1.14.0 to keep answers stable.
The content every question is about: text, or JSON with descriptive keys. Leave out fields no question needs.
Questions keyed by a name you choose; answers come back under the same names. Questions run in parallel and cannot see each other.
Images keyed by a placeholder string. Each placeholder in state, instructions or criteria is replaced by its image. Images are experimental at TypeSafe.
Raise the context limit from 64k (32k per question) to 262k tokens. Slower and less accurate, same price per token.
